'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Bombing of Zaporizhzhia (2022–present)|Bombing of Zaporizhzhia]]
****At least one person is killed and 14 others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[9K720 Iskander|Iskander]] missile strike on a hotel in [[Zaporizhzhia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-attacked-civilian-building-zaporizhzhia-officials-2023-08-10/ (Reuters)]
***Russian forces attack [[Toretsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], with [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar]]s and [[aerial bomb]]s, injuring at least six people. [https://kyivindependent.com/russian-air-strike-against-toretsk-donetsk-oblast-injures-6/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
***The [[Kupiansk]] city military administration says it will begin evacuating civilians from the [[Kupiansk Raion]] of the [[Kharkiv Oblast]] due to intense Russian shelling. [https://meduza.io/news/2023/08/10/v-kupyanskom-rayone-harkovskoy-oblasti-ob-yavili-obyazatelnuyu-evakuatsiyu-iz-za-usileniya-rossiyskih-obstrelov (''Meduza'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**At least 23 [[Syrian Army|soldiers]] are killed and ten more injured during an [[ambush]] by [[Islamic State]] gunmen against a military vehicle in [[Deir ez-Zor]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/11/at-least-20-syrian-soldiers-killed-in-ambush-blamed-on-isil (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2023 Hollywood labor disputes]]
**The American [[Academy of Television Arts & Sciences]] postpones the [[75th Primetime Emmy Awards]] until January 2024, due to the ongoing [[Strike action|strikes]] of the [[2023 Writers Guild of America strike|Writers Guild of America]] and [[2023 SAG-AFTRA strike|SAG-AFTRA]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230810-emmys-postponed-until-january-over-hollywood-strikes (AFP via France 24)]
*[[LGBT rights in Kuwait]]
**[[Kuwait]] bans the American film ''[[Barbie (film)|Barbie]]'' over [[homosexual]] content, with the [[Ministry of Culture (Lebanon)|Lebanese Minister of Culture]] proposing a similar ban. [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/barbie-banned-kuwait-homosexuality-1235560252/ (''The Hollywood Reporter'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/10/kuwait-bans-barbie-movie-as-lebanese-minister-calls-for-action-over-film (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2023]]
**[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
***The death toll from the [[wildfire]]s increases to 53, all in the town of [[Lahaina, Hawaii|Lahaina]] in western [[Maui]], [[Hawaii]], [[United States]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/10/dozens-killed-as-wildfires-ravage-hawaii-island-of-maui (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Maui County, Hawaii|Maui County]] officials report that the wildfire is 80% contained. [https://www.staradvertiser.com/2023/08/10/breaking-news/maui-recovery-efforts-continue-after-fires-kill-dozens-destroy-communities/ (''Honolulu Star-Advertiser'')]
***[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] approves a national disaster emergency declaration for Hawaii. [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/08/10/maui-fire-hawaii-biden-00110692 (Politico)]
**[[2023 Canadian wildfires]]
***[[Alaska]], United States, reports its worst [[air quality]] in recorded history after extreme amounts of smoke enter the [[U.S. state|state]]. [https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/amphtml/video/timelapse-shows-wildfire-smoke-blanket-224114685.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[Storm Hans]]
**After several days of heavy rains in [[Norway]], the town of [[Hamar]] floods the [[speed skating]] rink at the [[Vikingskipet]] arena in order to relieve the flooding in other parts of the town. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2486111-noorse-hamar-laat-ijsbaan-onderlopen-vanwege-stijgend-water-in-meer (NOS)]

'''Health and environment'''
*A [[mass grave]] is discovered near the city of [[Dzyarzhynsk]], [[Belarus]], believed to contain either the remains of a church cemetery, the inhabitants of the city's [[Jewish ghettos established by Nazi Germany|Jewish ghetto]], or [[Calvinism|Calvinists]]. [https://nashaniva.com/323727 (Nasha Niva)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Philippines relations]]
**[[President of the Philippines|Philippine President]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] suspends 22 [[land reclamation]] projects in [[Manila Bay]] due to environmental concerns and the involvement of [[State-owned enterprises of China|Chinese state-owned enterprise]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-manila-bay-land-reclamation-us-aff98eebcff8bb9b3d62eb3adea0f002 (AP)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] announces an agreement with [[Iran]] to repatriate five American citizens in exchange for access to [[United States dollar|$]]6 billion in blocked funds. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/iran-american-prisoners-house-arrest/ (CBS News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Assassination of Fernando Villavicencio]]
**[[President of Ecuador|Ecuadorian President]] [[Guillermo Lasso]] declares a [[state of emergency]] following the [[assassination]] of [[2023 Ecuadorian general election#Presidential candidates|presidential candidate]] [[Fernando Villavicencio]] in [[Quito]]. [https://www.elmundo.es/internacional/2023/08/10/64d48e7ce9cf4ad7718b45a3.html (''El Mundo'')]
*[[LGBT rights in Malaysia]]
**[[Malaysia]] bans the use of [[Swatch]] products containing [[LGBTQ]] elements, with users of these products facing up to three years in prison. [https://www.nbcnews.com/nbc-out/out-news/malaysia-makes-owning-lgbtq-swatch-punishable-3-years-jail-rcna99193 (AP via NBC News)]
*[[Criticism of Tesla, Inc.]]
**The [[National Highway Traffic Safety Administration]] opens an investigation into a fatal [[Traffic collision|vehicle crash]] in [[Virginia]], U.S., involving a [[Tesla Model Y|Model Y]] [[car|vehicle]] from [[Tesla, Inc.|Tesla]]. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/us-opens-new-investigation-into-fatal-tesla-crash-virginia-2023-08-10/ (Reuters)]
*The United States imposes coordinated [[United States sanctions|sanctions]] with [[Canada]] and the [[United Kingdom]] on former [[Banque du Liban|Lebanese central bank]] governor [[Riad Salameh]] and several of Salameh's associates for alleged [[embezzlement]] and [[money laundering]] of $300 million. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230810-us-uk-and-canada-sanction-lebanon-ex-central-bank-chief-salameh (AFP via France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[United States House Oversight Subcommittee on Government Operations|United States House Subcommittee on Government Operations and the Federal Workforce]] holds a televised investigative hearing on the U.S. government's response to and overall recovery efforts from [[Hurricane Ian]], which struck [[Florida]] in September 2022. '''Science and technology'''
*American [[spaceflight]] company [[Virgin Galactic]] launches its first [[space tourism]] flight, [[Galactic 02]]. [[Antigua and Barbuda]]n tourists [[Keisha Schahaff]] and [[Anastatia Mayers]] become the first mother-daughter duo and first people from the [[Caribbean]] to fly to space, while Mayers also becomes the youngest woman and second youngest person to fly to space.
